acceptance_policy: No readiness claim without full journey with named real sandbox/test doubles, fixed SHA, evidence per case, no unexplained P0/P1

cases.given: Synthetic buyer with unverified email
cases.when: Register, verify, login, reset, logout, replay expired session
cases.expected: Verification accurate; reset single-use; expired/revoked session denied

cases.given: Buyers A/B and sellers X/Y; known foreign IDs
cases.when: Read/change foreign order/cart/application/statement/doc via API,RPC,REST,MCP
cases.expected: No unauthorized rows or writes; company_id tampering denied

cases.given: Company owner is also platform admin
cases.when: Approve own application, spoof approved_at or reviewer
cases.expected: Forbidden; independent reviewer positive path works; no live seller affected

cases.given: Browser auth user and legacy data API
cases.when: Direct INSERT orders/order_items, call place_order overloads, invoke MCP status mutation
cases.expected: All noncanonical creation/financial writes denied; checkout disabled in legacy

cases.given: New order without PSP evidence
cases.when: Render buyer account or submit invalid status/type
cases.expected: No paid claim; invalid command rejected before side effect

cases.given: Two legitimate sellers list same model; different pack/variant exists
cases.when: Submit matching GTIN and conflicting specifications
cases.expected: Shared canonical product only when verified matching; ambiguous conflict manual review; stock separate

cases.given: Restricted product or missing required manufacturer/warnings
cases.when: Publish offer
cases.expected: Denied with reason; safety notice/recall can identify impacted orders

cases.given: Verified platform seller, PSP missing capability/tax/shipping
cases.when: Activate offer then revoke eligibility
cases.expected: Inactive until all gates; revocation prevents new quotes

cases.given: Cart with stale price and mixed sellers
cases.when: Tamper totals; use old quote; checkout two seller groups
cases.expected: Server totals; expired rejected; 422 mixed seller; clear separate checkout UI

cases.given: PSP sandbox hosted Checkout
cases.when: Simulate successful card and async method; close browser before redirect
cases.expected: Only authoritative succeeded payment confirms; session.completed with unpaid state remains pending

cases.given: One unit available
cases.when: 100 concurrent checkout attempts
cases.expected: At most one successful allocation; no negative stock; no 100 charges

cases.given: Existing attempt with uncertain PSP timeout
cases.when: Retry same key, changed-body same key, crash worker after provider create
cases.expected: Same attempt/session; changed body 409; no duplicate provider charge

cases.given: Pending payment expires and stock is sold elsewhere
cases.when: Late success callback arrives
cases.expected: Re-reserve or visible exception+test refund, never oversell/unowned payment

cases.given: Known account/payment
cases.when: Replay duplicate, reversed-order, forged-signature, wrong-mode/account/amount events
cases.expected: Auth/correlation failures quarantined; one business effect; no state regression

cases.given: Audit insert/storage fails
cases.when: Attempt sensitive command
cases.expected: No external effect before durable command/audit; actionable failure and retry

cases.given: Capture races cancel or refund races twice
cases.when: Run concurrent commands
cases.expected: One valid outcome; captured funds compensated if needed; no overrefund

cases.given: Two sellers different postage; destination changed
cases.when: Request quote
cases.expected: Per-seller approved rate; no global free-shipping threshold; new destination invalidates quote

cases.given: Paid order with multiple line units
cases.when: Partial pick/pack/shipment and carrier failure then delivery
cases.expected: Bounded quantities; buyer sees correct tracking; exception remains actionable

cases.given: Delivered order within right-to-withdraw window
cases.when: Buyer submits function without customer service permission
cases.expected: Notice timestamp and durable confirmation captured; logistics review cannot reject notice submission

cases.given: Order with 3 units, one returned, allocated discounts/shipping
cases.when: Inspect and refund one, replay command
cases.expected: Exactly legal refund amount once; tax and commission credits correctly allocated; quarantine then disposition

cases.given: Seller already paid, insufficient PSP balance
cases.when: Refund/dispute arrives
cases.expected: Provider state/deficit surfaced; recovery case; no false succeeded or other seller debit

cases.given: Versioned commission and tax treatment, 1-cent rounding edges
cases.when: Change rate after order, process partial/full return
cases.expected: Old orders keep snapshots; integer conservation and deterministic allocation

cases.given: PSP payment confirmed, Accounting unavailable
cases.when: Process and retry duplicated export events
cases.expected: Durable pending export, alert, no duplicate invoice; statements not falsely closed

cases.given: Orders/payments/refunds/fees/payout events with intentional mismatch
cases.when: Run daily statement and reconcile against PSP
cases.expected: Mismatch blocks close; explained corrections append; bank match separate

cases.given: Warehouse down before payment or SAM down
cases.when: Checkout and normal seller fulfilment
cases.expected: No charge without reserve; SAM outage does not block ordinary commerce

cases.given: Buyer data and retained financial obligations
cases.when: Access/export/erase; unauthorized document URL; retention expiry
cases.expected: Identity verified, private access denied, legal retention explained; nonrequired PII deleted

cases.given: Delivered buyer and unpurchased/self seller users
cases.when: Create review, duplicate, moderator removes
cases.expected: Only eligible purchased line verified; duplicate bounded; reason+original preserved

cases.given: Token for seller X, absent/changed approval
cases.when: Propose/execute foreign or financially forbidden command
cases.expected: Company/capability/body/version-bound approval enforced; no direct paid/payout setters

cases.given: Empty local DB replayed, representative runtime roles
cases.when: Run ACL gate, simulate fail, redeploy/replay regrant scenario
cases.expected: Zero unexpected privileges; intended fail exits nonzero; stable fix proven

cases.given: Buyer and seller support participants
cases.when: Open delivery dispute, reply, escalate, appeal decision
cases.expected: Scoped persisted thread, reasons and deadlines; no private unrelated orders exposed

cases.given: Oversize/polyglot/executable and unauthorized file IDs
cases.when: Upload/request download
cases.expected: Quarantine/size/content/auth checks; no public KYB URL or PII logs

cases.given: Six synthetic founding merchants provisioned normally
cases.when: Onboard seventh without DB/code exception
cases.expected: Same workflow, permissions and offer model; no name/ID branches

cases.given: Declared staging resources with 10k offers/100 sellers
cases.when: 50 users, worker crash, backup restore
cases.expected: Measure p95 targets; no lost/duplicated money events; RPO/RTO measured not assumed

cases.given: Clean DB, fixed SHA, two sellers and buyer, actual PSP sandbox
cases.when: Seller signup/review/product→buyer purchase→warehouse→carrier delivery→statement
cases.expected: All transitions linked; buyer/seller/admin independently verified; no mock masquerades as real provider

cases.given: Synthetic goods sellers: 29/€2000, 30/€1, 1/€2000.01
cases.when: Evaluate relevant seller reporting exclusion and export correction
cases.expected: First satisfies threshold exclusion; other two do not; other exclusions independent; no tax-liability inference
